create_ocr_config: create a QianfanOCRConfig with vision and text sub-configs for conditional generation
build_vision_model: build a QianfanOCRVisionModel with stochastic depth layers and mean pooling output
run_ocr_inference: run QianfanOCRForConditionalGeneration forward pass with pixel values to generate OCR text output
configure_vision_layers: configure QianfanOCRVisionLayer with attention, MLP, and drop path rate for transformer encoding
process_image_text: process images and text with QianfanOCRProcessor replacing image placeholders with token sequences
